title: JANUS Engine — Howl's Moving Castle RUN-005, POMS realistic-packing and startup screen
purpose: Replace the speculative 423.5 m2 flat-stack interpretation with a literature-grounded POMS packing density, include the user's startup insight as a transient readiness gate, and determine what auxiliary-power ceiling is compatible with a first self-driving demonstrator.

geometry.note: The 423.5 m2 R0A1 figure remains a high-area hollow-fiber screening concept, not a realizable flat POMS stack in this envelope.

membrane_and_flow_anchor.flow_distribution_target: substantially better than the published desktop module's approximate 25% actively flushed volume

conversion_efficiency_audit.meaning: derived from the small published prototype's observed 0.18-0.30 W versus measured O2 consumption
conversion_efficiency_audit.important_correction: RUN-004 conservatively extrapolated the prototype's low observed electrical conversion to the paper target flux. RUN-005 therefore carries both the empirical low-performance case and the paper's 55%-efficiency design case instead of conflating them.

auxiliary_budget_area_requirements.formula: A_break_even = P_aux / (J_O2 * e_electric_per_gO2), with J converted from mg/m2/s to g/m2/s
auxiliary_budget_area_requirements.design_discovery: A first demonstrator should minimize fixed parasitics rather than maximize membrane area. With the 21.2 m2 realistic flat POMS crown, a 10 W total auxiliary ceiling is compatible with the 0.064-0.13 target range only if PEMFC conversion approaches the design-efficiency case; under the measured small-prototype conversion, the same crown needs the upper end of the target flux and auxiliaries below roughly 10 W.

startup_inventory_screen.interpretation: For a direct gill/PEMFC architecture of similar gas-volume-to-membrane-area ratio, establishment of the oxygen gradient is naturally an hours-scale transient rather than an instantaneous switch. Membrane influx during drawdown makes these inventory-only times lower bounds.
startup_inventory_screen.full_VRU_AKS_note: The richer Mode B can require much longer stabilization because adsorption cycles must approach CSS and thermal/cryogenic inventories must condition. The user's historical 1-4 day startup experience is retained as a plant-specific precedent and motivates condition-based rather than clock-based readiness.

startup_state_machine.criterion: water and gas loops established, leak and humidity checks pass
internal pO2 falls below water-equivalent pO2 and oxygen influx becomes measurable
O2 membrane influx and PEMFC consumption converge within measurement uncertainty
auxiliaries progressively migrate from starter/buffer to PEMFC bus
positive net power and stable O2/humidity/temperature balances over repeated observation windows
if sorbent/VRU/AKS branch enabled, successive cycles meet declared cyclic-steady-state tolerance

main_result.selected_first_geometry: sectorized annular cross-flow flat-stack cassettes with distributed water headers
main_result.required_total_auxiliary_strategy: single-digit to low-tens of watts for first ignition, with every pump/fan/control watt measured
main_result.highest_priority_geometry_fix: flow distribution and boundary-layer renewal, because the published prototype actively flushed only about 25% of its volume and the nominal water-side mass-transfer resistance dominated membrane resistance
main_result.highest_priority_thermal_fix: prevent gas-side condensation from reducing effective POMS permeance

next_gate: R0A3_DISTRIBUTED_MANIFOLD_AND_PARASITIC_BUDGET: design one small POMS cassette with distributed water feed, measure active-flow utilization, J_O2, DeltaP, fan/blower W, humidity and condensation over an hours-scale startup/hold test; then scale the validated cassette to the 21.2 m2 crown.
